children: State Bank of India (SBI) has announced that Deepak Kaushik has been appointed Chief General Manager (CGM) of the Bank’s Bengaluru Circle, which covers the entire State of Karnataka.

Kaushik brings with him a career marked by experience. Prior to taking charge of the Bengaluru Circle, he served as SBI’s Country Head for East Asia at the Hong Kong Office, overseeing international banking operations and strategic business initiatives in the region.
The Bengaluru Circle, comprising 1,573 branches across Karnataka, is the Bank’s second-largest circle in terms of total business.

title: SBI appoints Deepak Kaushik as Chief General Manager of Bengaluru Circle
